so.t: Lise, the Player Shop clerk at the Check Room counter in Pioneer 2 (the Lab in Episode 2): open the Exchange tab. Works in a game with no quest loaded, not at the lobby or casino Player Shop stalls. Trade Photon Drops for Photon Shards.
Buy Photon Shards at the Prize Counter in Casino Voloyal (lobby 16): a pack of 5 for 10 casino coins once a day, and a pack of 35 for 60 casino coins once a week.

Pioneer Festival milestone reward: talk to Kanoni in the lobby to claim 50 Photon Shards for every milestone except 2, 4, 6 and 8. A milestone unlocks each time the whole server defeats another 5,000 enemies in Field of Caelum.
Complete a daily Hunter Mission (Hunter Missions tab in the main menu, or your Hunter's License) and claim it for 2 Photon Shards. You get three daily missions.
Complete a weekly Hunter Mission and claim it for 10 Photon Shards. You get three weekly missions.
Level achievements: when any character on your account reaches the level, claim the reward from Record/Achievements in the lobby.
Episode clear achievements: clear Episode 1, 2 or 4 on each difficulty (defeat the final boss in free roam or clear the episode's last government quest), then claim the reward in the lobby.
Government Agent achievements: complete every government quest of an episode, then claim the reward in the lobby.
Monster Hunter lifetime milestones: defeat enemies with your own final blow across your whole account, then claim each milestone.
Rare Collector lifetime milestones: collect different rare equipment models across your account (you do not have to keep them), then claim each milestone.
Pioneer Service lifetime milestones: complete quests across your account, then claim each milestone.
Open the clear boxes after defeating the Dioscuri twins in Project C.A.R.D.: Genesis.
Any non-boss enemy, and any ordinary breakable box, can drop a Photon Shard on any difficulty.

Paradigm Shift at Alesia (the Secret Doctor at the Medical Center counter in Pioneer 2 or the Lab, Photon Modifications screen): when she changes your class, she refunds the Photon Shards you spent on the Class Skills you lose.

000909.d: Forged by mass paranoia. Perhaps a paranoia for an apocalypse that was never going to happen.

t: Normal and heavy attacks are melee swings that hit up to 3 targets within 24 units, and they can strike Satellite Lizards from the front. The first swing of the combo hits twice.
Special: jump-dashes forward, then thrusts and fires a blast from the spike's tip that hits up to 5 enemies or boxes: the nearest takes heavy-attack damage, the others half.
You cannot be hurt for the first 0.3 seconds of the special, and it cannot be chained from other attacks.

000409.d: A throwable partisan that explodes in contact. Its power is unrivaled.

A wall ends the throw with a blast at half power. The spear flies back, and you can attack again as soon as you catch it.

008F09.d: Heathcliff Flowen's original sword, created by Mick Co. Purified with his soul, this sword retains Flowen's abilities.

t: Special: Dark Flow's wave crash in light blue, for 15% of maximum TP: five waves that pierce, each hitting up to 5 enemies once. It is refused below that, so a CAST (0 TP) cannot use it.
Normal and heavy attacks restore 3% of maximum TP for each enemy they hit.
A white silhouette trails the sword while you move.

With Flowen's Frame and Flowen's Shield, a Just Guard wraps the sword in a longer light-blue Dark Flow blade for 20 seconds: attack reach +50%, the wave crash 30% stronger, and 2% of maximum TP restored every 0.1 seconds.

Worn with Flowen's Frame, Flowen's Shield and any Flowen's Sword (the original, every dated replica or True): each piece's own stats are raised by 50%, the sword's ATP and ATA and the Frame's and the Shield's DFP and EVP.

so.t: Use Flowen's Soul with Dark Flow equipped.

000D09.d: Nei's own claws, one for each hand. Foie, Barta and Zonde gain 50% power. HUnewearl only.
ef: Claw attacks reach two targets. Normal combo hits restore 2% / 4% / 6% maximum TP; heavy attacks restore twice as much.
Foie, Barta and Zonde deal 50% more damage.
Same special as Nei's Claw (Real), fired on every swing of the special (5% TP each).
Every hit, the special's included, restores 1% of maximum HP.
Held by a HUnewearl wearing Neifirst Memory: Foie, Barta and Zonde gain that unit's effects.
